preconditions.description: Attacker must have some token balance to trigger overflow/underflow

exploit_hint: The contract uses SafeMath in most places but has unprotected arithmetic in the issue() and redeem() functions. As the owner, call issue() with a very large amount (close to uint256 max) to cause overflow in the require() statements, allowing minting of excessive tokens. Alternatively, if not owner, find unprotected arithmetic in transfer/transferFrom paths when SafeMath is not used (though the provided code shows SafeMath usage). The actual exploit would depend on finding the specific unprotected arithmetic operation.
